Put photos for page headers here (e.g. venue-hall.jpg).

Then, in the matching .md page’s front matter, add:

hero_image: /assets/images/venue-hall.jpg
hero_alt: "A short description of the photo, for accessibility"

See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full instructions.

Recommended photo size: at least 1600px wide, landscape orientation (wider than tall). Larger portrait photos will get cropped to fit the banner.
